paragraphs.en: LinkedIn is a soul-sucking hole of professionalism and a pit of hell that not even my worst enemy should spend the rest of his days in.
paragraphs.zh: 领英是一个吞噬灵魂的职业主义黑洞，是连我最痛恨的敌都不该在里面度过余生的地狱深坑。

paragraphs.en: It’s this concoction of performative productivity and corpo speak producing cursed artifacts beyond human comprehension.
paragraphs.zh: 正是这种表演式生产力与企业黑话的混合物，制造出了超越人类理解能力的诡异产物。

paragraphs.en: A place where normal human text goes to die and can only be kept alive by an LLM like a radiation protection suit.
paragraphs.zh: 普通人类文本走向死亡的地方，只有像防辐射服一样的 LLM 才能让它维持生机。

paragraphs.en: And I wanted to look into the performative projects people keep making that are all over my feed.
paragraphs.zh: 我还想研究一下人们不断创作的那些充斥在我信息流中的表演性项目。

paragraphs.en: It is legit the most unbearable stuff you would see.
paragraphs.zh: 这真的是你能见到的最难以忍受的东西。

paragraphs.en: My third cousin got hit by a truck🚚💥 today! Here’s what it taught me about business management👇
paragraphs.zh: 我的三代旁系表亲今天被卡车撞了🚚💥！ 这件事教给我以下关于企业经营管理的道理👇

sents.en: My third cousin got hit by a truck🚚💥 today!
sents.zh: 我的三代旁系表亲今天被卡车撞了🚚💥！

sents.en: Here’s what it taught me about business management👇
sents.zh: 这件事教给我以下关于企业经营管理的道理👇

paragraphs.en: And everyone carries this fake tone of being “visionary” and “forward-thinking” and “professional”
paragraphs.zh: 而且每个人都带着一种“有远见”“前瞻性思维”和“专业”的虚假腔调

paragraphs.en: And then you look at the projects they are posting.
paragraphs.zh: 然后你再看一下他们正在发布的项目。

paragraphs.en: Genuinely, every time I open LinkedIn, I get hit by these Computer Vision Projects of some guy waving his hand around, and it tracks them.
paragraphs.zh: 说实话，每次打开 LinkedIn，我都会被这些计算机视觉项目刷屏——总有某个人在挥手，然后系统就能追踪他的动作。

paragraphs.en: Like, I wouldn’t mind if it was one of these, but it is legit all I see. It is just every other post some guy waving his hand around doing NONSENSE.
paragraphs.zh: 比如说，如果只是偶尔看到这种我倒不介意，但我看到的全都是这些。 简直每隔一个帖子就有个家伙在那挥手摆姿势搞些无意义的鬼名堂。

sents.en: Like, I wouldn’t mind if it was one of these, but it is legit all I see.
sents.zh: 比如说，如果只是偶尔看到这种我倒不介意，但我看到的全都是这些。

sents.en: It is just every other post some guy waving his hand around doing NONSENSE.
sents.zh: 简直每隔一个帖子就有个家伙在那挥手摆姿势搞些无意义的鬼名堂。

paragraphs.en: It’s not even useful. It’s not even something anyone would like using. It’s just “look at me computer vision”
paragraphs.zh: 它甚至没什么用处。 它甚至不是任何人会喜欢使用的东西。 它只是“看看我，计算机视觉”

sents.en: It’s not even useful.
sents.zh: 它甚至没什么用处。

sents.en: It’s not even something anyone would like using.
sents.zh: 它甚至不是任何人会喜欢使用的东西。

sents.en: It’s just “look at me computer vision”
sents.zh: 它只是“看看我，计算机视觉”

paragraphs.en: I am pretty sure they either vibecode it or get it from a tutorial. cuz EVERY SINGLE ONE IS THE SAME.
paragraphs.zh: 我很确定他们要么就是凭感觉随手写的（vibecode），要么就是照着教程抄的。因为每一个都一模一样。

paragraphs.en: Btw, you wanna know how bad it is? This image I put? I didn’t even go digging for it. I literally just opened LinkedIn, and this was the first thing I saw…and the second…and the third…and the fourth…and the fifth…
paragraphs.zh: 顺便问一下，你想知道情况有多糟吗？我放的这张图？ 我甚至都没有特意去找。 我真的就是打开了 LinkedIn，这是我看到的第一条内容……然后是第二条……第三条……第四条……第五条……

sents.en: Btw, you wanna know how bad it is? This image I put?
sents.zh: 顺便问一下，你想知道情况有多糟吗？我放的这张图？

sents.zh: 我甚至都没有特意去找。

sents.en: I literally just opened LinkedIn, and this was the first thing I saw…and the second…and the third…and the fourth…and the fifth…
sents.zh: 我真的就是打开了 LinkedIn，这是我看到的第一条内容……然后是第二条……第三条……第四条……第五条……

paragraphs.en: I am not kidding; this was the second thing I saw just now.
paragraphs.zh: 我没有开玩笑，这是我刚才看到的第二个东西。

paragraphs.en: Also, the thing that gets me is that the first image is at least a game, not a good one, sure, but it is something. But this pothole detection. What is the point? You know what else could detect potholes? Eyes. They are very, very good at detecting those.
paragraphs.zh: 而且，让我无语的是，第一张图好歹是个游戏，虽然不算好，但至少是个东西。 可这个坑洞检测呢？意义何在？ 你知道还有什么能检测坑洞吗？眼睛。 眼睛检测这种东西可是非常非常在行的。

sents.en: Also, the thing that gets me is that the first image is at least a game, not a good one, sure, but it is something.
sents.zh: 而且，让我无语的是，第一张图好歹是个游戏，虽然不算好，但至少是个东西。

sents.en: But this pothole detection. What is the point?
sents.zh: 可这个坑洞检测呢？意义何在？

sents.en: You know what else could detect potholes? Eyes.
sents.zh: 你知道还有什么能检测坑洞吗？眼睛。

sents.en: They are very, very good at detecting those.
sents.zh: 眼睛检测这种东西可是非常非常在行的。

paragraphs.en: They are not sending it to anything. Like, if it was connected to all car cameras for detection, well, first, mass surveillance, and also if you have so many potholes you can’t keep track of them and need crowd-sourced data for potholes, you have WAYYY bigger issues, but sure. If it was sending the api somewhere, that would be cute. BUT IT’S NOT.
paragraphs.zh: 它并没有把数据发送到任何地方。 比如说，就算它连接了所有的行车摄像头来做检测，首先，这是大规模监控，而且如果你的道路上坑洼多到数不过来、需要靠众包数据来记录坑洼，那你面临的问题可就大得多了，不过行吧。 如果它真的把数据发送到某个 API，那倒是挺可爱。但它根本没有。

sents.zh: 比如说，就算它连接了所有的行车摄像头来做检测，首先，这是大规模监控，而且如果你的道路上坑洼多到数不过来、需要靠众包数据来记录坑洼，那你面临的问题可就大得多了，不过行吧。

sents.en: If it was sending the api somewhere, that would be cute. BUT IT’S NOT.
sents.zh: 如果它真的把数据发送到某个 API，那倒是挺可爱。但它根本没有。

paragraphs.en: The bigger idea is to use AI for smart infrastructure monitoring, where road conditions can be assessed more efficiently, and maintenance teams can make better data-driven decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 更大的构想是利用人工智能进行智能基础设施监测，从而更高效地评估道路状况，并让维护团队能够做出更好的数据驱动决策。

paragraphs.en: This project also showed me that real-world computer vision is not just about detecting objects; lighting, road conditions, camera angles, and overlapping detections can all affect performance.
paragraphs.zh: 这个项目还让我认识到，现实世界中的计算机视觉不仅仅是检测物体；光照、路况、摄像头角度以及重叠的检测结果都会影响性能。

paragraphs.en: How difficult is it to produce one of these projects that looks impressive on LinkedIn?
paragraphs.zh: 在 LinkedIn 上做出一个看起来令人印象深刻的项目有多难？

paragraphs.en: I decided to make a detector for the “🚀 Excited to announce I made a YOLO project” posts.
paragraphs.zh: 我决定做一个检测器，用来检测“🚀 兴奋地宣布我做了一个YOLO项目”这类帖子。

paragraphs.en: I am learning this from scratch; I’ve never done this before. I just wanna see how hard it could be. Can’t critique cooking without ever cooking ramen.
paragraphs.zh: 我是从零开始学这个的，以前从来没做过。 我只是想看看这到底能有多难。 从没煮过拉面，就没资格评判烹饪。

sents.en: I am learning this from scratch; I’ve never done this before.
sents.zh: 我是从零开始学这个的，以前从来没做过。

sents.en: I just wanna see how hard it could be.
sents.zh: 我只是想看看这到底能有多难。

sents.en: Can’t critique cooking without ever cooking ramen.
sents.zh: 从没煮过拉面，就没资格评判烹饪。

paragraphs.en: It won’t be useful, but now you will know slop is in fact slop.
paragraphs.zh: 它不会有什么用处，但至少你现在会知道这些“垃圾内容”（slop）确实就是垃圾内容。

paragraphs.en: It took me an hour and a half to learn and make the whole thing, and most of it was just drawing boxes and waiting for the model to be trained.
paragraphs.zh: 我花了大约一个半小时来学习和制作整个东西，其中大部分时间只是在画框和等待模型训练完成。

paragraphs.en: Okay, so the first part of making this is data. You need to train your model on some data that show the model what one of these posts looks like.
paragraphs.zh: 好的，制作这个东西的第一部分是数据。 你需要用一些数据来训练你的模型，让模型了解这类帖子的样子。

sents.en: Okay, so the first part of making this is data.
sents.zh: 好的，制作这个东西的第一部分是数据。

sents.en: You need to train your model on some data that show the model what one of these posts looks like.
sents.zh: 你需要用一些数据来训练你的模型，让模型了解这类帖子的样子。

paragraphs.en: I wrote this script to collect the images. It scrolls through my feed and takes screenshots:
paragraphs.zh: 我写了这个脚本来收集图片。 它会滚动浏览我的信息流并进行截图：

sents.en: I wrote this script to collect the images.
sents.zh: 我写了这个脚本来收集图片。

sents.en: It scrolls through my feed and takes screenshots:
sents.zh: 它会滚动浏览我的信息流并进行截图：

paragraphs.en: mkdir -p raw_data sleep 5 # to switch to browser for i in { 1..200} ; do scrot "raw_data/slop_$( printf "%03d" $i ).png" xdotool key Page_Down sleep 3 done My script has collected 200 images, which should be good enough for now.
paragraphs.zh: mkdir -p raw_data sleep 5 # 切换到浏览器 for i in { 1..200} ; do scrot "raw_data/slop_$( printf "%03d" $i ).png" xdotool key Page_Down sleep 3 done 我的脚本已经收集了 200 张图片，目前来说应该足够了。

paragraphs.en: Now I created a Roboflow account, created my project, and uploaded my screenshots.
paragraphs.zh: 现在我已经创建了 Roboflow 账户，创建了我的项目，并上传了我的截图。

paragraphs.en: I just had to scroll through the screenshots and annotate them by drawing a box around the things I think need to be detected. It was pretty mechanical. Took about 20 minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 我只需要浏览这些截图，并在我认为需要被检测到的东西周围画个框进行标注。 这过程相当机械，花了大约 20 分钟。

sents.en: I just had to scroll through the screenshots and annotate them by drawing a box around the things I think need to be detected.
sents.zh: 我只需要浏览这些截图，并在我认为需要被检测到的东西周围画个框进行标注。

sents.en: It was pretty mechanical. Took about 20 minutes.
sents.zh: 这过程相当机械，花了大约 20 分钟。

paragraphs.en: Once the images were annotated, I just exported them in the YOLOv8 format and downloaded the zip file of my dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 图像标注完成后，我只需以 YOLOv8 格式导出它们，并下载我的数据集的 zip 文件。

paragraphs.en: Now it was time to train the model. And that can be done with basically no effort.
paragraphs.zh: 现在是时候训练模型了。 而这几乎可以毫不费力地完成。

sents.en: Now it was time to train the model.
sents.zh: 现在是时候训练模型了。

sents.en: And that can be done with basically no effort.
sents.zh: 而这几乎可以毫不费力地完成。

paragraphs.en: from ultralytics import YOLO model = YOLO( 'yolov8n.pt' ) results = model.train( data = 'dataset/data.yaml' , epochs = 50 , imgsz = 320 , name = 'slop_detector' ) great! Just wait for the training to finish. It took me 30 mins cuz I have a potato pc.
paragraphs.zh: from ultralytics import YOLO model = YOLO('yolov8n.pt') results = model.train(data='dataset/data.yaml', epochs=50, imgsz=320, name='slop_detector') 太棒了！ 只需等训练完成就行。 花了我30分钟，因为我的电脑配置很烂。

sents.en: from ultralytics import YOLO model = YOLO( 'yolov8n.pt' ) results = model.train( data = 'dataset/data.yaml' , epochs = 50 , imgsz = 320 , name = 'slop_detector' ) great!
sents.zh: from ultralytics import YOLO model = YOLO('yolov8n.pt') results = model.train(data='dataset/data.yaml', epochs=50, imgsz=320, name='slop_detector') 太棒了！

sents.en: Just wait for the training to finish.
sents.zh: 只需等训练完成就行。

sents.en: It took me 30 mins cuz I have a potato pc.
sents.zh: 花了我30分钟，因为我的电脑配置很烂。

paragraphs.en: Once the training finished, I wrote the Python script to run the model.
paragraphs.zh: 训练完成后，我编写了 Python 脚本来运行模型。

paragraphs.en: from ultralytics import YOLO import sys def main ( image_path ): model = YOLO( 'runs/detect/slop_detector/weights/best.pt' ) model(image_path, save = True , conf = 0.10 ) main(sys.argv[ 1 ]) YAYYY I got my very own slop detector!!!
paragraphs.zh: from ultralytics import YOLO import sys def main ( image_path ): model = YOLO( 'runs/detect/slop_detector/weights/best.pt' ) model(image_path, save = True , conf = 0.10 ) main(sys.argv[ 1 ]) 耶耶耶！我拥有了自己的“垃圾内容检测器”！！！

paragraphs.en: I think I can finally add computer vision expert, Python savant, and AI and ML thought leader to my resume.
paragraphs.zh: 我想我终于可以在简历上加上“计算机视觉专家”、“Python 大师”以及“AI 和 ML 思想领袖”这些头衔了。

paragraphs.en: Yeah, it took me an hour and a half to learn and build the whole thing. It’d be more interesting if they were optimizing the models or pushing the accuracy or whatever, but most of what you see on LinkedIn is just this: pretty trivial stuff with cool marketing on top.
paragraphs.zh: 是的，我花了一个半小时学习并把整个东西搭建出来。 如果他们是在优化模型或者提升准确率之类的，那会更有意思，但你在领英上看到的大多只是这种：包装着炫酷营销的相当浅显的东西。

sents.en: Yeah, it took me an hour and a half to learn and build the whole thing.
sents.zh: 是的，我花了一个半小时学习并把整个东西搭建出来。

sents.zh: 如果他们是在优化模型或者提升准确率之类的，那会更有意思，但你在领英上看到的大多只是这种：包装着炫酷营销的相当浅显的东西。

paragraphs.en: And nobody says anything because your comments show up on your profile. If a recruiter scrolls through and sees you calling slop slop, you’re the asshole. So everyone claps and moves on.
paragraphs.zh: 而且没人说什么，因为你的评论会显示在你的个人主页上。 如果招聘人员翻看时看到你把垃圾内容叫作垃圾内容，你就是那个混蛋。 所以大家都鼓掌，然后就翻篇了。

paragraphs.en: That’s the real problem. Nothing on that site rewards you for getting better. It’s a platform built around selling yourself for a job, so what survives isn’t skill; it’s looking interesting. It’s just LARPing productivity. Go to some of these profiles, and it’s the same guy detecting potholes over and over and over with zero signs of improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 这才是真正的问题。 那个网站上没有任何东西会奖励你的进步。 它是一个围绕「把自己推销出去找份工作」而搭建的平台，所以能留存下来的不是技能，而是显得有趣的样子。 这不过是cosplay式（LARP）的 productivity。 去看看那些个人主页，你会发现是同一个人在反复检测坑洼，一次又一次，毫无进步的迹象。
